# lumos_user_roles (Data Source)

UserRoles DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lumos_user_roles" "my_userroles" {
  user_id = "...my_user_id..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) The UUID of the user whose roles are listed.

### Read-Only

- `roles` (List of String) Names of the roles currently assigned to the user.
